test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The politician’s __pompous__ rhetoric during the campaign failed to garner much support from the public.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Supercilious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pompous **means having an exaggerated sense of one's importance; characterized by an ostentatious display of dignity or self-importance. (**गर्वित**)

 
 
• **Example**: *His pompous speech about his achievements alienated his colleagues.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Supercilious **means displaying haughty disdain or contempt; looking down on others with arrogance. (**अभिमानपूर्ण**)
 
 
• **Example**: *The supercilious attitude of the wealthy socialite made her unpopular among her peers.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym for Pompous is Supercilious.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conciliatory: **Intended to reconcile or make peace; showing a willingness to end conflicts or disputes. (**मिलाप करनेवाला**)
 
• **Benign: **Gentle, kind, and harmless; having a favourable or beneficial effect. (**सौम्य**)
 
• **Diplomatic: **Relating to the skill or conduct involved in managing international relations or negotiations; tactful and skilful in dealing with people. (**कूटनीतिक**)
